summary: Advances a circular-buffer read index by one with modulo wrap. Reads the read index (this+0x9BC) and compares it with the write index (this+0x9B8); when they are equal the buffer is treated as empty and the read index is returned unchanged. Otherwise computes the wrapped successor v2 = (read+1) % size, stores it into the read index slot (this+0x9BC), where size is this+0x9B4, and returns the wrap quotient (read+1) / size. Called by sub_4B7860 (004B7860).

local_names.result: read index; after an advance, the wrap quotient (read+1)/size
local_names.v2: new read index value (read+1) mod size

If the read index equals the write index this[622] (this+0x9B8), the buffer is empty: skip the advance and return the read index unchanged.
Compute the wrapped successor v2 = (result+1) % this[621] (modulus this+0x9B4) and the wrap quotient result = (result+1) / this[621].
Write the wrapped successor v2 back into the read index slot this[623] (this+0x9BC).
Return the read index unchanged when write equals read, or the wrap quotient (read+1)/size after an advance.
